pli-tv-kd19:4.1.11: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo bhūtaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.12: sace upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.13: abhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no bhūtanti. na taṃ upāli, attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.14: sace pana upāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.15: bhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no abhūtanti. tenupāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.16: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo atthasaṃhitaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.17: sace upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.18: anatthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no atthasaṃhitanti. na taṃ upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.19: sace pana upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.20: atthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no anatthasaṃhitanti, tenupāli bhikkhunā uttari paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.21: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe udāhu noti,
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.22: sace pana upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.23: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno na labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkheti na taṃ upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.24: sace pana upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.25: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkheti, tenupāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.26: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṅghassa tato nidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo saṅghabhedo saṅgharāji saṅghavavatthānaṃ saṅghanānākaraṇaṃ udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.27: sace upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.28: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṅghassa tato nidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ …pe… saṅghanānākaraṇanti. na taṃ upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.29: sace pana upāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.30: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato na bhavissati saṅghassa tato nidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ …pe… saṅghanānākaraṇanti. ādātabbaṃ taṃ upāli attādānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.31: evaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ kho upāli attādānaṃ ādinnaṃ pacchāpi avippaṭisārakaraṃ bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.1: codakena bhante bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena kati dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabboti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.2: codakena upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabbo.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.3: codakena upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.4: parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu khomhi parisuddhenamhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appatimaṃsena. saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.5: no ce upāli bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appatimaṃsena. tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.6: iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassūti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.7: puna ca paraṃ upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.8: parisuddhavacīsamācāro nu khomhi parisuddhenamhi vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appatimaṃsena. saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.9: no ce upāli bhikkhu parisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhena vacīsamācārena samannāgato
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.11: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vācasikaṃ sikkhassūti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.12: puna caparaṃ upāli, codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.13: mettaṃ nu kho me cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ sabrahmacārīsu anāghāti, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti?
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.14: no ce upāli bhikkhuno mettacittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghāti, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.15: iṅgha tāva āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettaṃ cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpehīti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.16: puna caparaṃ upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.17: bahussuto nu khomhi sutadharo sutasanniccayo. ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpā me dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.18: no ce upāli bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti. tathārūpassa dhammā na bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. tassa bhavanti vattāro
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.19: iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassuti: itissa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.20: puna caparaṃ upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.21: ubhayāni kho me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti?
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.22: no ce upāli bhikkhuno ubhayāni pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso- idaṃ panāvuso kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatāti iti puṭṭho na sampāyati. tassa bhavanti vattāro
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.23: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇassūti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.24: codakena upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabboti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.2.1: codakena bhante bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena kati dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabboti?
pli-tv-kd19:5.2.2: codakena upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo:

pli-tv-kd19:5.3.10: yathā na aññopi bhikkhu abhūtena codetabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
